name: [Equip] Gemini is thinking again (paid tokens nobody reads)
message:
BLOCKED — DO NOT IMPORT YET. `equip.gemini.tokens_thinking_total` is written to the logs by `app/services/translation/gemini.py` but has no log-based-metric rule in Datadog, so the metric does not exist and this monitor can never fire. Re-verified 2026-08-19: fourteen `equip.*` metrics reported in the last thirty days and this is not one of them, while a direct query for this series returns nothing and `tokens_output_total` returns points over the same window. Create the rule first — `docs/datadog/README.md`, 'Creating the missing thinking-token metric', has the exact query, value field and tags. `scripts/apply_datadog_monitors.py` refuses to create a monitor whose message opens with this word, so this file stays inert until the line is deleted.

The translation model is spending 'thinking' tokens. Translation does not need them, they are invisible in the reply, and they are billed as output.

Production ran on `gemini-flash-latest` for 81 days at ~840 thinking tokens per translated string — six times the output it actually produced — and nothing showed it, because nothing measured it. This monitor is that measurement.

Measured on 2026-08-17: `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` spends **zero** on this work. Setting `thinkingBudget: 0` does NOT switch it off on a thinking model (1227 → 1066); only choosing a different model does.

What to check: `GEMINI_MODEL` in the backend's Vercel production environment.
